<section>
<markdown>## What a join does

A join combines rows from related tables in one statement. The keys link the tables: a foreign key in one table matches the primary key in the other. <img src=x onerror=alert(1)> [click](javascript:alert(1))</markdown>
<mermaid>graph LR; O[Orders] -->|customer_id| C[Customers]</mermaid>

</section>
<section>
<markdown>## Inner joins

An inner join returns only the rows that have a match in both tables.</markdown>
<cite>1, 2</cite>
</section>
<section>
<markdown>## Left joins

A left join keeps every row from the left table, even with no match on the right.</markdown>
